coordinates.note: Coordinates are a geocode of the Observatory's own stated headquarters address (Av. San Martin Norte 304, Malargue), not a survey point for the 3000 km² surface-detector array itself, which is centred roughly 30 km away and extends around this campus/administrative point. No fetched official or technical source gives decimal coordinates for the array's own geometric centre.
coordinates.quote: Av. San Martín Norte 304 Malargüe, Mendoza, Argentina

name: Pierre Auger Observatory campus, Malargüe
notes: No altitude is recorded: no official or technical source consulted states a specific altitude figure for this campus point or the array average.
The array is 'extended': individual surface-detector stations and fluorescence buildings are spread across ~3000 km² around this point; the coordinates of individual stations are not recorded.

summary.plain: The administrative campus of the Pierre Auger Observatory in the town of Malargue, Argentina, at the centre of a much larger cosmic-ray detector array spread over the surrounding plain.
summary.technical: Headquarters/campus site of the Pierre Auger Observatory in Malargue, Mendoza Province, Argentina; the 3000 km² surface-detector array and fluorescence buildings extend around this administrative point at an average altitude reported elsewhere as roughly 1400 m (not sourced in this record).
